reviewer: Kimi independent actual visual comparison of the exact native source, enlarged source page 03, complete unchanged native RGBA raw, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged naiwa mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: Short dark combed-back hair with receding temples and thick dark eyebrows remains. One prominent dark upper-lip moustache sits above a single stern closed mouth; the chin and jaw remain smooth with no beard, and no glasses or headgear were added. The slight viewer-left three-quarter head/gaze, formal upper-chest crop and warm directional cheek shadows remain. The charcoal notched-lapel suit, white pointed shirt collar and one pale-gray tie are retained. The rounded chin meets a short broad neck transition and fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted dark frame, opaque dark blue-gray mottled photographic backing, overlapping warm-cream note with compact upper gray marks and mostly blank lower paper, and small right-edge tab remain. Full white/cyan comparisons show no visible interior holes, lost backing or working-matte outer ring.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept the native RGBA transparent exterior outside the complete frame/note silhouette. Actual white/cyan/alpha inspection found no visible holes or missing backing; 252-254 alpha values were not used as a rejection shortcut. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The source note's gray marks are indistinct shapes rather than readable text; their compact upper-paper presence was checked without claiming an exact transcription.
